resources.string: This app does not start dsh and bundles no runtime; it only hosts the dsh web server you already run on your computer.
Not recognised: needs an http(s) URL or a pairing code from the desktop shell

Tip: in the Linux desktop shell open “File → Phone / tablet pairing…” to show a QR code, or paste the tokenized URL printed by dsh web. The token is only used once to obtain a 30-day session cookie on this device.
This clears the saved URL and cookie on this device; you will need to pair again.
Point at the pairing QR code from the desktop shell
Camera permission denied; paste the URL instead.
Storage permission granted, tap the download again.
Not signed in: pair again (the token expired, or this address is not authorised).
No browser available for this link
This does not look like dsh web. Check the address, port and scheme, or open it in a browser first.
Loading timed out: the address did not answer. Check it or your network.
Cannot reach the saved address. Enter it again or scan the pairing code.
